name: Linux runtime (gamescope + native ARM Steam)
note: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 rootfs with gamescope 3.16, Xwayland, Mesa 26.2 (Turnip with the KGSL backend, Zink), GTK 2, PulseAudio and Bannerlator's session scripts. Installed by the app into files/linuxfs; a gamescope session refuses to start without it. r3 sets every installed title to the ARM64 Proton the Steam client already downloads, so Windows games launch without picking a compatibility tool per game. Contains no Valve software - the native arm64 Steam client is fetched from Valve at first use. Built from tools/linuxfs in the Bannerlator repo; ported from WinNative's gamescope runtime (GPL-3.0).
